'''Tong''' was a female [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] with [[Salle Serpa]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] troopers sent with him to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] to take the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Academy]] there hostage. After Serpa learned that [[Alema Rar]] had been in the Praxeum, he ordered her to report anything out of the ordinary.
